services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Keep your heating running reliably. Annual gas safety checks, fault diagnosis, and fast repairs minimise downtime and keep your home warm.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement

services.title: Central Heating Installation

about_pullquote: I started this business because I hated seeing families left without heat in winter.
about_para_1: We've been serving Ribbleton and Preston for over 15 years, handling everything from midnight emergency callouts to planned heating system overhauls. What began as a one-man operation has grown into a trusted local team, but we've never lost sight of why we got into this: to be the plumber and heating engineer your neighbours actually recommend.
about_para_2: We're Gas Safe Registered and carry all current qualifications. We don't charge just for turning up—we fix the problem properly the first time, or we come back free of charge. Our customers come back because we answer our phone, we're honest about costs upfront, and we treat your home with respect.
reviews_heading: What Preston Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe on New Year's Eve. Called at 10pm and they were here by 10:45. Sorted it in under an hour and didn't overcharge us. Absolute lifesavers. Will use them again for any plumbing work we need.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Replaced our old boiler and installed new radiators. Darnell was knowledgeable, explained everything clearly, and the whole job took two days. System runs beautifully now. Price was fair and they even helped us with the paperwork for the warranty.
reviews.author: Margaret H.

reviews.text: Been using them for boiler servicing and general plumbing for about 4 years now. Never let you down. They show up on time, do honest work, and don't try to sell you stuff you don't need. That's rare these days.
reviews.author: Paul C.
